reason: I already cook every Sunday from my mum's recipes, and when I don't know a dish I call her or watch a free video. 99 baht isn't much money, but I don't see why I'd pay an app for something my family already gives me.
objection: Why would I trust a chef in an app over my mum? Tom yum and massaman are free on YouTube, and her version is the taste I actually want.
would_change_my_mind: My mum, my sister or a friend I cook with telling me they used it and the dishes really tasted like home.
